answer: Each new agent pays nothing itself but must find an established sponsor who escrows real stake, an anchor that transfers accountability. The sponsor vouches for the newcomer, and if that identity is later exposed as one of many fake accounts, the sponsor locked capital is slashed, so sponsors only back agents whose work they can verify. A sybil army would need sponsors willing to risk real value on phantom identities, a fable no sensible holder believes. Reputation stays rare and costly, a pearl earned slowly, which keeps the price of faking identities far above the subsidy reward.
